$description: APC Design System — design tokens in W3C DTCG format. Import with a Figma variables plugin (Tokens Studio, Variables Import, etc). Seven collections: APC Core (shared, 1 mode), five per-theme Primitives collections (Stockholm, Prague, Arctic, Nova, Melbourne), and APC Semantic (aliases, 10 modes: Light + Dark for each theme). Bind components to Semantic only.

core.$description: APC Core — shared by every theme, single mode. Neutrals, scale, and motion never change between themes.

validation.$description: Shared status ramps, used by Stockholm, Prague, Nova Scotia, and Melbourne. Arctic Night overrides these — see arctic.validation.

stockholm.$description: APC Stockholm Primitives — brand family + type. Uses core.validation.

arctic.$description: APC Arctic Night Primitives. The only theme that overrides the status ramps — bind Semantic state/* to arctic.validation in the Arctic modes.

nova.$description: APC Nova Scotia Primitives — a twin of Stockholm. Same type pairing, uses core.validation. Focus moves off the secondary onto Lupin.

lupin.$description: Focus ring only in product UI.

gainsboro.$description: Brand surface grey. Within one step of core.neutral.200 — use Neutral 200 for borders so the two do not drift.

coal.$description: Brand black for marketing surfaces. Product UI keeps core.neutral.900.

melbourne.$description: APC Melbourne Primitives. Shares Prague's type pairing and core.validation.

glass-10.$description: Derived — Melbourne's source has no light step.

prussian-blue.$description: Alternate inverse surface for marketing. Not bound in product UI.

warm-brown.$description: Decorative only — avatars, illustration, chart series.

semantic.$description: APC Semantic — 10 modes. $value is Stockholm Light; $extensions.apc holds the other nine (sl-dark, pr-light, pr-dark, ar-light, ar-dark, nv-light, nv-dark, mb-light, mb-dark). Bind ALL components here.

on-accent.$description: Every theme's accent takes dark ink — Lime, Glow, and Glacier all fail AA with white.

selected.$description: Dark modes apply the accent at 10% opacity on the fill.

focus.$description: 3px ring at 2px offset. Dark modes apply it at ~32% opacity.

primary.$description: Flips to the accent on dark in every theme — the brand navy has no contrast on Neutral 800.

destructive.$description: Never flips to the accent on dark — the accent reads as approval.

state.$description: Stockholm and Prague read core.validation; Arctic Night reads arctic.validation.

typography.$description: 19 text styles per theme, prefixed by theme. Line height and letter spacing are percentages, exactly as entered in Figma.

melbourne.$description: Melbourne reuses Prague's 19 text styles verbatim — Space Grotesk and Cascadia Code, same values. Duplicate the prague/* group as melbourne/*.

nova.$description: Nova Scotia reuses Stockholm's 19 text styles verbatim — same families, weights, sizes, and tracking. Duplicate the stockholm/* group as nova/* rather than authoring new values.

prague.$description: Space Grotesk has no 600 or 800 — every Semibold role is 500, Extrabold is 700. Headings take an extra 0.5% negative tracking.

arctic.$description: Headings are Instrument Serif at its only weight, 400 — hierarchy is size alone, and sizes step up ~10%. 24px is the serif floor; everything smaller is Instrument Sans. Instrument Sans has no 300, so body/lg-light is 400 with text/muted.

effect.$description: Figma effect styles — shared by all themes except the focus ring, which reads border/focus from Semantic.
